frequency_question: How often do announced structural Treasury/Fed intervention programs scale up to target maximum volumes within two years of inception?
membership_rule: Includes major liquidity, buyback, or intervention programs initiated since 1990; excludes one-off emergency interventions lasting under 3 months.
coverage_note: 8 named major structural programs; represents the full population of modern U.S. central bank/treasury balance sheet scaling phases.
known_gaps: Minor technical facility adjustments excluded as they do not constitute major structural programs.
skeleton: 8 major structural intervention programs identified across 3 decades, representing distinct operational scaling cycles.
validity_reason: Macroeconomic intervention frameworks and debt management institutional behaviors evolve slowly over multi-decade horizons.
